name: RealBio
description: RealBio — an open, objectively-scored, cross-system benchmark for real-world bioinformatics-agent tasks (routing, param-prefill, protocol QC, autofix, workflow-gen, BOIN, PBPK, drug-discovery). Run your system on the fixed items, score with the shared score.py, land on the leaderboard. CC-BY-4.0.
